# technitium_dhcp_reserved_lease (Resource)

Reserves an IP address in a DHCP scope for one device. Changing any attribute replaces the reservation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "technitium_dhcp_reserved_lease" "nas" {
  scope            = technitium_dhcp_scope.lan.name
  hardware_address = "00-11-22-AA-BB-CC"
  ip_address       = "192.168.1.10"
  host_name        = "nas"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hardware_address` (String) The device's MAC address, in upper case separated by dashes, for example `00-11-22-AA-BB-CC`.
- `ip_address` (String) The address reserved for the device.
- `scope` (String) The name of the DHCP scope.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Comments stored with the reservation.
- `host_name` (String) The host name to give the device instead of the one it sends.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <scope>/<hardware address>
terraform import technitium_dhcp_reserved_lease.nas lan/00-11-22-AA-BB-CC
```
